_comment: Every knob of scripts/avatar/avatar-render.py. Values below are the ones that survived review on the PR-290 run (<org>, 2026-09-30): neutral palette derived from a headshot, short hair, two-tone beard, no glasses, plain white shirt, translucent static card. Only the three starred keys cannot be sampled from a photo.

_notes.hair_length: short = tapered sideburns ending above the ears; long adds a mass behind the head and reaches the shoulders
_notes.beard: jaw and chin only — the renderer never lets it reach the cheekbone
_notes.beard_dark / beard_warm: two-tone gradient, sideburns -> chin; keep beard_dark near `hair` so the beard reads as the same person
_notes.glasses: keep lens_alpha <= 12 — anything darker reads as sunglasses
_notes.shirt_style: plain | trim (burgundy placket + buttons) | gingham (white with burgundy checks)
_notes.card_alpha: 168 ~= 66% opaque: the app shows through, the figure stays solid
_notes.ring_width/ring_alpha/shadow_alpha: static card furniture — nothing on the card animates by design
